## How was it tested?

- [ ] `swift test` passes (Swift 6.4 or later, which compiles the shaders), or `xcodebuild test -scheme SwiftShaders -destination 'platform=macOS'`
- [ ] `xcodebuild test` passes on an iOS simulator
- [ ] A new or changed shader has a test that renders it and checks the pixels
- [ ] A new shader function is listed in `LibraryTests.expectedFunctions`
- [ ] README samples and `Examples/ShaderGallery/ShaderGallery/ReadmeSamples.swift` still match
- [ ] README translations updated, or noted here if `README.md` changed
- [ ] README images regenerated with `scripts/generate-screenshots.sh` if an effect looks different
